speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

title: MulmoTerminal — Settings lists every shortcut, bound or not
description: Short feature clip. Settings' read-only Keyboard shortcuts section lists every action as bound or Not set — and Set up shortcuts… has the agent write the config for you. Slides are English in both language versions.

beats.text: Settings lists every keyboard shortcut, bound or not — so you can see what is left to bind.
